title: Needs Remediation
description: Reference prototype preserving the original POC's baseline → exploration → HiFi model for a filter-header redesign.
question: How might a saved operational view explain its fixed definition without presenting that definition as removable filters?

dontMiss: One stable view name, matching navigation and breadcrumbs.
The saved view definition is copy, not a set of removable filter chips.
User-controlled filters narrow within the fixed view definition.
Existing table behaviour is preserved; the design question is the filter/header model.
ignore: Alternative explorations that did not converge
A redesign of the underlying message table
